lines: Big Congratulations to our dear student Deepanshu for his accomplishment to pursue his final year at IIT Madras which shows the quality of many of our students is as good as IITians. Best wishes and good luck to Deepanshu for the successful completion of his final year BTech at IIT Madras.
Dr Kishorjit Nongmeikapam bagged a 5 lakhs consultancy work for "Machine-aided Translation of Three Criminal Laws pf India from English to Manipur", funded by Department of Law, Govt. of Manipur

Dr L Sarbajit Singh and Dr Akoijam Malemnganbi received a 1.2 lakh project work on "Text to Text/Speech Parallel Corpus creation of most commonly used phrases and sentences in English and Manipur", funded by DST, Govt. of Manipur.
Mr. Udit and Mr. Vinayak Sinha, students of 3rd Year BTech CSE selected for summer internship at IIT Madras, which may lead to VII and VIII Semester Exchange, and direct PhD admissions at IIT Madras

Ms. Aditi Vidyarthi, Ms. Aditi Mishra, Mr. Aman Maurya, Mr. Gannamraju Sai Koushik completed the Certificate Course in Sanskrit Language offered at IIIT-Manipur. Certificates are also issued by Central Sanskrit University, New Delhi, equivalent to Eight Credits.
Dr. Kishorjit Nongmeikapam received a project grant of Rs. 243.82 Lakhs from MeitY, Govt. of India for the project
ISHAAN: A system for Bidirectional Machine Translation between 1) English and Assamese, Bodo, Manipuri, Nepali 2) Manipuri and Hindi 3) Assamese and Bodo

Mr. Shivam Sharma (18010121), a student of BTech in Computer Science & Engineering and Mr. Aditya Raj (18010210), a student of BTech in Electronics and Communication Engineering bagged 46 Lakhs LPA from Amazon India.
Mr. Ritu Raj Choudhary (20010115), a 2nd year student of BTech Computer Science & Engineering finds 'bug' in Google.
Congratulations to Mr. A. Sai Charan (20010132), a 3rd year student of B.Tech. Computer Science & Engineering has been selected for the prestigious FOSSEE 2023 Summer Internship at IIT Bombay.
